title: A Basic Rise
summary: Rises gently after a dose, holds for a while, then comes back down.

title: A Delayed Rise
summary: The point where the curve starts to rise is pushed later.

title: A Rise That Doesn't Reach as High
summary: It rises, but the peak stays low.

title: Almost No Change
summary: The curve barely moves even after the dose.

title: A High Peak
summary: Rises steeply in a short time and peaks high.

title: A Fast Drop
summary: Comes down steeply even though the peak looks similar.

title: A Shorter Held Stretch
summary: The dosing interval stays the same, but each held stretch gets shorter and shorter.

title: Around the Peak, and the Descent After It
summary: A wide, high stretch appears near the peak, followed by the way down.

title: No Second Rise in the Afternoon
summary: Rises with the morning dose, but stays low with the afternoon dose.

title: A Whole Day, Repeated
summary: The rise and fall that only shows up when you look at the whole day at once.

title: Same Medication, a Different Curve on a Different Day
summary: Overlaying two days on the same dose to see exactly what was different.
